title: American Integrity Vice President of Claims Trevor McDonald Named PropertyCasualty360’s 2026 Claims Leader of the Year
summary: National recognition honors McDonald’s leadership in building one of the property and casualty industry’s most trusted, innovative, and customer-focused claims organizations American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. (NYSE: AII) (“American Integrity,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”), a Tampa-based property and casualty insurance holding company and one of Florida’s leading providers of residential property insurance, today announced that its Vice President of Claims, Trevor McDonald, has been named PropertyCasualty360’s 2026 Claims Leader of the Year in the Insurance Carriers category. The honor is part of the national Insurance Luminaries Awards, which recognizes claims executives whose leadership, innovation, and commitment to policyholders are helping shape the future of the property and casualty insurance industry.
